title: 💥 “The Church That Won’t Wash Feet… Will Always Count Heads.” 💥
paragraphs:
💥 “The Church That Won’t Wash Feet… Will Always Count Heads.” 💥
😅 Funny — until you realize it’s true.

Because sometimes we get so busy counting people…
that we forget to serve them. 🫧

📖 Jesus didn’t count heads — He washed feet.
He didn’t build stages — He built people. 🙌

🔥 Maybe revival doesn’t start with numbers…
but with a towel and a little humility. 🕊️

John 13:14–15 (NIV)
“Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.”
